chapter_title: Concerning the Three Things that were established

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
By the inevitable order of Divine wisdom proceeding from Divine love, a complete provision must be brought into fixed being; it cannot fail, because without it the primal opposition to the Divine would not be finally restrained. That opposing falsity must be held fast by what is thus established, since from the beginning it set itself against what is from heaven, and therefore the Divine order necessarily brings forth the means of its binding.

First, a new ultimate plane must be established: an external degree made luminous with truth and stable for the reception of good. It is set above the former ultimate, and founded as a higher, purified external in which what is foreign to heaven can find no footing, nor form a supporting base for itself.

Second, the ruling infernal love that burns to destroy truth, together with the falsity that cleaves to it, must be completely shut up within that new ultimate. The ultimate itself becomes the fixed containing form of restraint, so that this evil and its attendant persuasion cannot flow out, act, or extend itself.

Third, all who by their own works have united themselves with evil and falsity must come into a final state according to what they have willed and done. Over them is grief, because they have confirmed themselves in what is against good; and by the opposition they chose, they are fixed in conjunction with that dominant falsity which exalted itself against the Divine greatness.

Then the last restraint is made complete when every counterfeit good and every fabricated appearance of truth, in whatever variety, is immobilized within that final containment, so that it cannot shift form, disguise itself, or escape. By this permanent bond, all such states are held for ever in abasement and impotence, made to serve only as the lowest and most contemptible support of that enclosing confinement. And this restraint stands as an impassable limit and a vast separation between infernal falsity and infernal evil, so that they cannot reach each other, cannot communicate, and cannot even take in one another’s persuasions; thus they become barren of further production, because they are severed from one another to eternity.

paragraph_translations.translation: By the inevitable order of Divine wisdom proceeding from Divine love, three fixed outcomes must be brought into being. No other course and no other end is possible, because the primal opposing falsity must be restrained by them—this adversary that from the beginning rose against what is Divine. Therefore these outcomes cannot be withheld from coming into effect, since without them that opposition would not be finally bound.

The first outcome is the establishment of a new ultimate plane made luminous with truth, set above the former ultimate and founded as a higher external. In this purified external, what is alien to heaven can no longer take hold, build itself up, or draw any support for its continuance.
paragraph_translations.notes: The phrasing about an 'alien body' is hard to render without the natural image; taken here as what is foreign to heaven seeking a base in the ultimate.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second outcome is the complete confinement of the infernal love that burns to destroy truth, together with the falsity that accompanies it, within that new ultimate plane. Thus the new ultimate becomes the fixed containing form in which this evil is shut up and prevented from going forth into action.
paragraph_translations.notes: The pairing of 'dark fire' with 'companion' forces the sense of an evil love with its attendant falsity.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third outcome is the final state of all who have made themselves sinners by their works and are therefore judged from what they have done. Over them is grief, because they are condemned according to the wicked deeds they committed; and for this reason they are fixed in conjunction with that ruling adversarial falsity which had lifted itself up against the Divine greatness.
paragraph_translations.notes: The image of being 'crucified on' the enemy is rendered as being fixed in conjunction with the dominant opposing falsity.

paragraph_translations.translation: The final containment is sealed when every counterfeit form of good and every fabricated appearance of truth, of whatever variety, is fastened within that last restraint so it can no longer shift or escape. By this permanent bond they are held for ever in a state of abasement, serving only as the lowest support of that enclosing confinement. This restraint is established as an impassable limit and a vast separation between infernal falsity and infernal evil, so that they cannot reach one another, cannot communicate, and cannot even take in each other’s persuasions; thus they become barren, because they are separated from one another to eternity.
paragraph_translations.notes: The sequence 'footstool and a mat and a rag' compresses into a single spiritual idea: utter abasement and use only as the lowest support; the multiple terms feel emphatic rather than distinct.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Highly coherent as a single teaching: a necessary threefold establishment—new ultimate plane, confinement of ruling evil and its falsity, and fixation of the condemned by their own works—followed by a final sealing that immobilizes all counterfeit forms and enforces eternal separation of evil and falsity so they cannot mutually reinforce. The only mild strain is the cluster of abasement images in the last paragraph, which reads as rhetorical intensification rather than distinct spiritual steps.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential setup: the chapter frames a necessary threefold functional provision (things that must come about because they perform the binding). No jurisdictional listing, no named administrators, no rank inventory.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by function/necessity: “Three things would be fashioned by the Light through necessity… For the darkness, the enemy, must be bound by them.” The spiritual reading reports no stumble here (“OPENS”) and can derive the sense directly from the text’s causal logic (they must exist because they bind).

findings.diagnosis: Mostly clean correspondential mapping (a new ‘earth’ as an ultimate boundary/plane), with mild lexical/translation strain caused by damaged/uncertain wording around the bracketed clauses and the phrase “alien body.” This is not an insertion; it is a hard image with lacunae.
findings.evidence: Functional correspondence is intact: “new luminous earth… set and built on top of this earth… [and no one will be able to build upon] it… that alien body [which will not be able to be] built upon it.” The spiritual reading notes the only difficulty: “The phrasing about an ‘alien body’ is hard to render… taken here as what is foreign to heaven seeking a base.” The brackets signal reconstruction/damage; the narrative does not break, it just becomes textually rough.

findings.diagnosis: Clean correspondential confinement motif: the ‘new earth’ functions as container/prison for ‘dark fire’ and the enemy. The reading’s slight forcing (“companion” → attendant falsity) is interpretive but does not indicate a second voice.
findings.evidence: Text remains functional: “They will [shut him up]… bind him in the new earth, the coffin [and the prison]… of the dark fire, the companion of the enemy.” No named ranks or jurisdictions; the key action is restraint-by-container. The spiritual reading calls it “DEVELOPS” and only notes semantic pressure from the pairing (“dark fire” + “companion”), not a narrative seam.

findings.diagnosis: Clean moral-teleological third member of the triad (fate of sinners) integrated with the binding theme. The vivid image “crucified on the enemy” is stark but still functions within the same restraint narrative; not an administrative overlay.
findings.evidence: Text continues the threefold establishment: “The third thing is the souls of all the sinners… condemned by their deeds… due to this they will be crucified on the enemy.” The spiritual reading notes only image-handling (“rendered as being fixed in conjunction”), not any intrusion of foreign material. No new named figures or governance schema appear.

findings.diagnosis: Rhetorically intensified but still coherent correspondential ‘sealing/boundary’ conclusion. The only stumble is stylistic multiplication (“footstool… mat… rag”), which reads as emphatic synonymy, not as a different didactic mode or a seam expansion. No administrative markers; the chapter’s story flows through it.
findings.evidence: Text teaches by what the final restraint DOES: “They will seal up this final lump… all the likenesses and images… nailed in it… bound… for eternity… placed as a footstool and a mat and a rag… placed… a boundary-marker and a great void… so that they cannot reach one another, nor can they hear their voices… become sterile.” The spiritual reading flags the only strain: “The sequence ‘footstool and a mat and a rag’… feel emphatic rather than distinct.” That is precisely a rhetorical piling-up inside the same functional argument (abasement + separation), not an inserted administrative catalog.

textual_criticism.summary: No textual-critical disruptions detected. All paragraphs sustain a single correspondential teaching (three necessary functional establishments culminating in a sealing boundary). Minor difficulties are best explained by damaged/uncertain wording (¶3–4 brackets) and rhetorical intensification (¶6), not by administrative overlay, seam expansion, or insertion. Recommendations: excise 0; annotate 0; none 5.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Three things would be fashioned by the Light through necessity. For there can be no other way nor other result, to allow them to stay without coming about. For the darkness, the enemy, must be bound by them; he who stood up against the Light from the beginning. Due to this, these things have no (other) result, to allow them to stay without coming about.

Now, the first thing is the new luminous earth, which was set and built on top of this earth [and no one will be able to build upon] it, namely that alien body [which will not be able to be] built upon it.
The second thing is this: They will [shut him up] and they [will bind him in] the new earth, the coffin [and the prison] ⟨p.105⟩ of the dark fire, the companion of the enemy.

The third thing is the souls of all the sinners who have been condemned by their deeds. They were [judged, and there is] over them woe; they have been condemned according to the wicked deeds they had committed, and due to this they will be crucified on the enemy, he who had raised himself up against the greatness.

They will seal up this final lump when all the likenesses and images of every shape will be nailed in it. Also, those will be bound by this last fetter for eternity, and be placed as a footstool and a mat and a rag for this coffin [and prison] which is the prison of the enemy. It will be placed, being a boundary-marker and a great void between the two, between the darkness and the enemy, so that they cannot reach one another, nor can they hear their voices; rather they will become sterile as they are separated from each other for ever and ever.

changes_summary: No changes made. The textual criticism findings recommend none for ¶2–¶6 (Findings 1–5), with no excisions or annotations required.
